name: Great Barghest Hero Cloak — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Great Barghest Hero Cloak from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Cloak, Great Barghest Hero" but are not part of the Great Barghest Hero Cloak entry, which is unchanged.

DESCRIPTION

This cloak looks like a gray wolf’s pelt, including legs and tail; the clasp is a wolf’s tooth.

You gain a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

This item has an associated deity. If you worship the associated deity or a goblin barghest hero once per day you can polymorph into a wolf or a wolf-goblin hybrid for up to 7 minutes (the hybrid form resembles a barghest’s natural form but has the same statistics as a wolf).
